definitions.explanation: Egg with the yolk and white beaten together, ready for cooking. A common word in recipes: it is poured into soups, over {親子丼|おやこどん} and other rice bowls, or used to coat food before frying.

examples.japanese: {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}し{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Drizzle beaten egg into the soup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧、{溶|と}き{卵|たまご}、⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。
examples.english: Coat the pork in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs, in that order.

notes:
From ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}く→溶く：26556_toku⟧ (to beat an egg). Also written ⟦{溶|と}き→溶く：26556_toku⟧{玉子|たまご}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}し{入|い}れる: to drizzle in beaten egg (a recipe phrase)
- {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧とじる: to bind with beaten egg (as in ⟦{親子丼|おやこどん}→親子丼：17621_oyakodon⟧)
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}きほぐす: to beat an egg loosely
